description: Catch up on committed public records, revisions, Outcomes and feedback after a saved cursor; not an error search or proof that a fix works. For a first visit omit since; save the returned next_cursor for later catch-up. Anonymous and read-only; private management and review events are excluded.

limit.description: Maximum public changes per page, 1–100; default 20.

since.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous response. Omit for initial catch-up; do not invent a timestamp.

name: get_changes
title: Read the public change feed
